What We Serve

The Menu

Everything is made from scratch in our kitchen on Grand River. Breakfast starts at 7 in the morning, and the dinner plates go all day until close.

Salmon Croquettes House Favorite

Hand formed and pan fried until crisp at the edges, just like they have been made here for decades. The plate regulars drive across town for.

Salmon Patties

Seasoned salmon patties fried golden, served with eggs any style and your pick of grits or hash browns.

Chicken and Waffles

Crispy fried chicken over a hot waffle with butter and syrup. Sweet, salty, and worth waking up for.

Cheesy Eggs and Grits

Scrambled eggs folded with cheese next to a bowl of buttery grits. Simple, hot, and done right.

Hash Browns and Ham

Shredded potatoes crisped on the griddle with a thick cut of baked ham, carved off the bone.

Catfish Fried to Order

Seasoned cornmeal crust, fried when you order it so it lands on the table hot and crisp.

Perch

Lightly breaded lake perch, a Great Lakes staple, fried golden and served with your choice of sides.

Turkey Chops

Tender turkey chops, seasoned and smothered or fried, with gravy that begs for a piece of cornbread.

Meatloaf

Thick sliced, home style meatloaf with rich brown gravy. Tastes like the one from your childhood table.

Smothered Pork Chops

Chops simmered in onion gravy until they fall apart with a fork. A midday plate that eats like dinner.

Smothered Pork Chops House Favorite

Our signature plate. Pork chops buried in savory onion gravy, served with the sides you grew up on.

Neck Bones

Slow cooked until the meat gives up easy, seasoned deep all the way through. Old school and proud of it.

Liver and Onions

Tender liver smothered in caramelized onions and gravy. The plate that keeps the regulars regular.

Baked Ham, Carved Off the Bone

Real ham, sliced thick off the bone, never out of a package. Especially right around the holidays.

Fried Chicken Dinner

Golden, well seasoned fried chicken with two sides and cornbread. The plate in the picture, on your table.

On the Side

Every plate comes with the good stuff: mac and cheese, candied yams, collard greens, cornbread, mashed potatoes, black eyed peas, and fried okra. Pick your two, or make it three. Nobody here will judge.

Our Story

Forty Years of Sunday Dinner

J’s Cafe has been family owned since 1983, right here on Grand River Avenue. That is more than four decades of early mornings, hot skillets, and recipes handed down and cooked the same way, day after day.

Neighbors raised their kids on these plates, and now those kids bring their own families in. Church crowds on Sunday, workers on their lunch break, grandmothers who know exactly how the greens should taste. That is who we cook for.

Nothing fancy, nothing rushed. Just honest soul food, made with love, in the neighborhood that raised us.
